symptom: Training died when ssh/agent session ended
likely_cause: Run started in foreground of the session
diagnostic: Check tmux ls on the remote; no session exists
fix: Always start long runs in a named tmux session on the remote; report the session name

symptom: Cannot tell if remote run is stuck or progressing
likely_cause: No per-step logging to a file
diagnostic: Log file missing or silent for long gaps
fix: tee output to artifacts/<run>.log with timestamps; tail over ssh; add per-epoch progress lines

symptom: Command debugged on the wrong machine
likely_cause: Machine for each command never stated
diagnostic: Ask: where do the data GPU and credentials live?
fix: Run the whole debug loop on the target machine over ssh; state machine per command

symptom: Model download fails on the server
diagnostic: curl a public URL from the server
fix: Download on laptop; scp/rsync into the shared HF cache; set HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1; load from local path

symptom: Code on VM differs from laptop
likely_cause: Files scp-ed over a git checkout or pull skipped
diagnostic: git -C project status and log on both machines
fix: Sync only via commit/push/pull; never scp source files

symptom: Changes landed on the wrong branch on the VM
fix: Check branch first; if wrong: commit then cherry-pick to correct branch and reset the wrong one

likely_cause: Model or data on CPU not GPU
diagnostic: nvidia-smi shows no process or 0 util
fix: Verify .to(device) on model and batches; print parameter device at startup

likely_cause: Wrong venv; driver/toolkit mismatch; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty
diagnostic: python -c torch.cuda.is_available inside the SAME venv
fix: Match torch build to driver; fix env vars; confirm nvidia-smi works at all

symptom: tmux session cannot be found later
likely_cause: Session unnamed or never verified at start
fix: Name every session; verify it started and tail the log immediately after launch

symptom: Tracking server unreachable from VM (or laptop)
likely_cause: UI and API reachable from different networks
diagnostic: curl the tracking URI from each machine
fix: Jobs log via the URI reachable from the VM; humans browse via port-forward from laptop; never hardcode localhost in job code

likely_cause: Job using raw object-store credentials instead of the tracker API
diagnostic: Check whether upload goes through the tracking server proxy
fix: Use the tracking server's artifact API; do not require direct bucket access from clients

symptom: Run finished but tracker still shows RUNNING
likely_cause: Process killed before end-run call; no finally block
diagnostic: Check run status vs log file end
fix: Wrap runs in try/finally that terminates the run status; backfill-terminate stale runs

symptom: Remote job started by automation dies at automation timeout
likely_cause: Agent timeout applied to the job itself
diagnostic: Compare job wall time vs automation limit
fix: Automation starts the job in tmux and exits; progress checked in later invocations

symptom: Large file transfer restarted from zero after drop
fix: Use rsync -avP (resumable); verify checksum after transfer
